```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

# Grace
library(rms)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(riskRegression)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(splines)
library(lubridate)
test_dates = c(ymd("2024-09-01"),ymd("2024-10-15"),ymd("2024-12-01"),ymd("2025-01-15"),ymd("2025-03-01"),ymd("2025-04-15"),ymd("2025-06-01"),ymd("2025-07-15"))

# load Rdata files: models and test set
base::load("MICE-mods.Rdata")
base::load("mortality-model-options.Rdata")
base::load("mortality-modelF-linear.Rdata")
base::load("eight-sets-test.Rdata")
base::load("mort-pred-fun.Rdata")
eight_sets_test = eight_sets_test_modC %>%
    select(-(week_from_baseline:prob_outcome_6wk))
```

# Compare performance w/ MI models
```{r}
# compare coefficients
all.equal(names(coef(mortality_modelC)),names(pooled_coefsC))
summary(coef(mortality_modelC) - pooled_coefsC)
cbind(coef(mortality_modelC),pooled_coefsC)
all.equal(names(coef(mortality_modelF_linear)),names(pooled_coefsF))
summary(coef(mortality_modelF_linear) - pooled_coefsF)

# get predictions
eight_sets_test_modCmice = pred_data_fun(eight_sets_test,modelC_tmp)
eight_sets_test_modFmice = pred_data_fun(eight_sets_test,modelF_tmp,linear_spline=T)

# create one test set with model predictions
eight_sets_test_mod = full_join(eight_sets_test_modC %>% select(PX_ID,current_date,int,
                                                                rank,uscrs,uscrs_trim,status_flipped,
                                                                time,outcome,albumin,bilirubin,
                                                                eGFR,sodium,BNP,BNP_NT_Pro,
                                                                durable_LVAD,short_MCS_ever,status,
                                                                prob_outcome_6wk_modC=prob_outcome_6wk,
                                                                haz_dth_modC=haz_dth_nowk),
                                eight_sets_test_modF %>% select(PX_ID,current_date,int,
                                                                prob_outcome_6wk_modF=prob_outcome_6wk,
                                                                haz_dth_modF=haz_dth_nowk),
                                by=c("PX_ID","current_date","int")) %>%
  full_join(.,
            eight_sets_test_modCmice %>% select(PX_ID,current_date,int,
                                                prob_outcome_6wk_modCmice=prob_outcome_6wk)) %>%
  full_join(.,
            eight_sets_test_modFmice %>% select(PX_ID,current_date,int,
                                                prob_outcome_6wk_modFmice=prob_outcome_6wk))

# initialize lists
auc_results <- list()
p_val <- list()
roc_plot <- list()

# Loop through datasets to compute AUC
for (i in 1:length(test_dates)) {
  data_i <- eight_sets_test_mod %>% filter(int==i)
  auc_tmp <- Score(
    list("uscrs 2.0 simple" = data_i$prob_outcome_6wk_modC, "uscrs 2.0 complex" = data_i$prob_outcome_6wk_modF,
         "uscrs 2.0 simple MI" = data_i$prob_outcome_6wk_modCmice, "uscrs 2.0 complex MI" = data_i$prob_outcome_6wk_modFmice),
    formula = Hist(time, outcome) ~ albumin + log(bilirubin + 1) + 
              eGFR + sodium + log(BNP + 1) * BNP_NT_Pro + 
              durable_LVAD + short_MCS_ever + status,
    data = data_i %>% 
              mutate(time = ifelse(outcome == 0, time + 0.001, time)),
    cens.method = "ipcw", cens.model = "cox",
    conf.int = TRUE,
    times = 42,
    metrics = c("auc"),
    conservative = TRUE,
    plots = "roc"
  )
  roc_plot[[i]] <- auc_tmp$ROC$plotframe %>% mutate(Date=test_dates[i])
  p_val[[i]] <- auc_tmp$AUC$contrasts
  auc_results[[i]] <- auc_tmp$AUC$score %>%
    mutate(interval = paste0("Interval_", i))  # Add dataset identifier
}
auc_df <- bind_rows(auc_results) %>%
  mutate(Model=factor(model,levels=c("uscrs 2.0 simple","uscrs 2.0 simple MI","uscrs 2.0 complex","uscrs 2.0 complex MI"),labels=c("US-CRS 2.0 -\nSimple","US-CRS 2.0 -\nSimple MI","US-CRS 2.0 -\nComplex","US-CRS 2.0 -\nComplex MI")))

# add dates
auc_df$Date <- rep(test_dates, each = dim(table(auc_df$Model)))

# plot results
ggplot(auc_df,
       aes(x = Date, y = AUC, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, color = Model, shape=Model)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 32),alpha=.85) + # ,alpha=.85
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(width = 32),width=15,,alpha=.85) + #  # 
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 32),size=2.5) +
  labs(
    #title = "Figure 1: AUC of US-CRS 2.0 compared to\nstatus quo (6-status with waiting time tiebreakers)",
    x = "Cross-section start date",
    y = "Time-dependent AUC (6-week mortality)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), 

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    
    text=element_text(size=12),
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(.5, "lines")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = as.numeric(test_dates),
    labels = format(test_dates, "%m/%d/%Y"),
    minor_breaks=F
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(15,18,12,9)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#31688EFF","#1FA187FF","#440154FF","#4AC16DFF"))
ggsave("uscrs_auc_comparison-MICE.png", width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```
